jobs.title: VP, Product & Technology
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We’re looking for a Vice President, Product & Technology to lead the strategy, development, and delivery of our platform and products across a large, multi-disciplinary organization spanning Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and Delivery, while taking advantage of every opportunity created by AI.

This is a senior executive role responsible for defining where the company is going — and ensuring the organization can execute against that vision at scale. You will shape product strategy, guide long-term platform evolution, drive operational excellence, and lead the evolution toward an AI-first approach to software development.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape the next generation of a platform used by millions of people, influence company strategy, and lead a talented organization through its next stage of growth and evolution.

Job Description

Vice President, Product & Technology

At BiblioCommons, we believe great technology organizations are built at the intersection of bold product vision, exceptional execution, and deep customer understanding.

We’re looking for a Vice President, Product & Technology to lead the strategy, development, and delivery of our platform and products across a large, multi-disciplinary organization spanning Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and Delivery, while taking advantage of every opportunity created by AI.

This is a senior executive role responsible for defining where the company is going — and ensuring the organization can execute against that vision at scale. You will shape product strategy, guide long-term platform evolution, drive operational excellence, and lead the evolution toward an AI-first approach to software development.

What You’ll Do

Product Vision & Strategy

Define and evolve the company’s product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with company objectives and market opportunities
Deeply understand customer needs, market dynamics, competitive trends, and emerging technologies, particularly the opportunities created by AI
Translate strategic priorities into clear product direction and investment decisions
Partner closely with executive leadership on company strategy, growth initiatives, and long-range planning
Champion customer-centric thinking and measurable product outcomes across the organization

Technology Leadership & Execution

Lead end-to-end execution across the Product & Technology organization, building teams and operating models that balance innovation, velocity, quality, and discipline
Establish AI-first software development as a fundamental way of working, embedding AI throughout engineering, product development, testing, and delivery to materially improve productivity, quality, and speed
Drive predictable execution, effective planning and prioritization, and continuous improvement across the product development lifecycle
Ensure technical and architectural decisions support long-term scalability, reliability, maintainability, and business goals

Organizational Leadership

Develop and mentor senior leaders across Product and Technology
Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and experimentation with new AI-enabled ways of working
Lead the organizational and operating-model changes required to realize the potential of AI-first software development
Communicate vision, priorities, and progress clearly across the organization and serve as a key member of the executive leadership team

What We’re Looking For

Proven executive leadership experience overseeing both Product and Engineering/Technology functions
Track record of defining successful product strategy and delivering complex software products at scale
Demonstrated experience adopting and scaling AI-first software development practices, with a strong point of view on how AI is fundamentally changing how modern software organizations operate
Experience leading large, multi-functional technology organizations through significant growth, transformation, or organizational evolution
Deep understanding of modern software development, product management, platform architecture, and AI-enabled development practices
Strong strategic thinking combined with a pragmatic, execution-oriented mindset
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to balance long-term innovation with near-term delivery commitments

Nice to Have

Experience in SaaS, platform, or enterprise software environments
Experience in mission-driven, education, civic, or public-sector technology organizations

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to shape the future of a product platform used by millions of people while building a modern, AI-first Product & Technology organization capable of delivering exceptional customer experiences at scale.

You’ll have the ability to influence company strategy, lead outstanding teams, and help define the next generation of our products, technology, and how we build software.

jobs.title: VP Senior Applied AI Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a senior technical leader specializing in building high-performance, interactive data visualization platforms and enterprise reporting engines. This is an expert-level role focused on creating advanced, web-based analytical applications that combine rich, interactive frontends with highly optimized, data-intensive backends and distributed query engines. A mandatory and critical secondary focus of this role is the design and creation of custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. You will build the bridge between LLMs/AI agents and our enterprise data layers, including Starburst, enabling AI to autonomously and securely query, analyze, and report on massive datasets.

Core Responsibilities

You will own the end-to-end design and delivery of sophisticated FinTech tools used directly by investment bankers, front-office traders, and financial analysts. This requires translating complex financial workflows into intuitive, high-fidelity web interfaces. Your primary focus will be on architecting and building highly interactive, web-based analytical dashboards using Angular and React, allowing users to slice, dice, and explore massive datasets in real-time.

A key function is leveraging Starburst (Trino) to query massive, distributed datasets with sub-second latency. You will design and implement robust backend microservices (Java/Spring Boot) optimized for low-latency data retrieval, heavy aggregation, and streaming large datasets to the frontend. Furthermore, you will be responsible for designing and optimizing scalable ETL processes to manage huge volumes of financial data.

A mandatory responsibility is to design, build, and maintain custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools. This enables AI agents and LLMs to securely interface with internal databases, APIs, and reporting engines. You will also architect enterprise-grade document generation engines using the Aspose suite to programmatically create high-fidelity financial reports from complex templates.

As a hands-on player/coach, you will deliver complex data visualizations and reporting engines while mentoring junior engineers. This includes critically reviewing and taking ownership of all AI-generated code (Java, Angular, React, SQL) to ensure structural integrity, security compliance, and production readiness, while applying a deep functional understanding of Corporate and Investment Banking (CIB) to all projects.

Key Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience:

Systems Fundamentals: Strong foundation in systems analysis, design patterns, data analysis, and the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including unit testing and CI/CD practices.
Backend Development: Extensive hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot for building scalable, low-latency microservices and reactive data streaming APIs.
Frontend & Visualization: Strong, hands-on experience with Angular 19+, React, TypeScript, HTML5, and Web Sockets for building interactive, data-intensive dashboards.
Data Federation & Querying: Hands-on experience with Starburst (Trino) for querying massive, distributed datasets across federated enterprise data sources.
Databases & Data Modeling: Deep experience with relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB), including physical/logical database design, data modeling, and performance tuning.
ETL & Data Processing: Proven experience designing high-throughput ETL pipelines and optimizing data flows for real-time reporting.
Enterprise Reporting: Experience building document generation engines using the Aspose suite (Aspose.Words, Aspose.Cells, Aspose.PDF).
MCP Tool Creation: Demonstrated ability to design and build custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to securely connect LLMs and AI agents to enterprise data.
AI-Assisted Engineering: Hands-on proficiency with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and the ability to write structured prompts and engineer high-quality context (schemas, API specs) for AI agents.
Collaboration Tools: Strong experience with GitHub for source control and Jira for project management.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

8+ years of relevant experience
Experience designing and implementing agentic AI workflows and integrating AI agents directly into CI/CD pipelines.
A strong understanding of event-driven systems and real-time message streaming platforms like Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.

Domain

Functional understanding of Banking — able to articulate why their work matters, not just how it is built.

What Sets This Role Apart

This is not a conventional engineering role. You are expected to operate as a force multiplier — directing AI agents across multiple workstreams, validating output for production safety, and coaching others to do the same. The measure of success is not lines of code written, but outcomes delivered, quality maintained, and the team's collective capability raised.
